apps.name: Cloudgate Shop
apps.description: A complete online store: catalogue with variants and stock, cart and hosted card checkout through Cloudgate Wallet, order tracking, and a full back office for products, inventory, orders, refunds, customers, content pages, email and theme colours.
features: Card payments through Cloudgate Wallet, sandbox and production
Products with variants, images, stock ledger and low-stock alerts
Orders with shipping, tracking, refunds and customer emails
Editable pages, contact form, newsletter, theme colours and branding
Back office for IdP users with the Admin role

summary: You are the merchant of record for everything sold through this store.
Payments settle to your Cloudgate Wallet; Cloudgate fees apply per the platform terms.
You are responsible for your store's legal pages, taxes and customer support.

compliance.label: Test store only
compliance.text: This copy uses the sandbox wallet and test cards. I will not share it with real customers.

compliance.label: Legal pages before selling
compliance.text: I will replace the template Terms, Privacy and Shipping & returns pages with my own wording before taking live orders.

compliance.label: Customer support
compliance.text: I will set a monitored support email and my business address and hours in the store settings.

compliance.label: Tested in sandbox
compliance.text: I have placed and refunded a test order in a sandbox copy of this store.

apps.name: Cloudgate POS
apps.description: A complete point-of-sale system: a touch-friendly till that scans barcodes with the device camera or a USB scanner, cash and card payments through Cloudgate Wallet, parked sales, returns and shift cash-ups, plus a back office for products, inventory (goods received and stock takes), sales, shifts, customers, reports and receipts.
features: Camera and USB barcode scanning at the till and when capturing inventory
Cash with change, and card payments by QR code through Cloudgate Wallet
Shifts with opening float, cash in/out and Z reports; parked sales and returns
Inventory with goods-received notes, stock takes, ledger and label printing
Back office for Admins only; tellers sign in to the till with the Teller role

summary: You are the merchant of record for everything sold through this till.
Card payments settle to your Cloudgate Wallet; Cloudgate fees apply per the platform terms.
You are responsible for tax on receipts, refunds and the cash in your drawers.

compliance.label: Test till only
compliance.text: This copy uses the sandbox wallet and test cards. I will not use it for real sales.

compliance.label: Receipt details before trading
compliance.text: I will set my business name, address, tax number and tax rate in Settings before printing receipts for customers.

compliance.label: Individual teller accounts
compliance.text: Each cashier gets their own user with the Teller role so shifts and cash-ups are attributable.

compliance.label: Tested in sandbox
compliance.text: I have rung up, refunded and cashed up a test sale in a sandbox copy of this app.

apps.name: Cloudgate Booking
apps.description: A configurable booking site and business back office: a media library, service photos, custom categories, staff, resources, availability, payments, customer accounts and appointment management.
features: Modern back office with grouped navigation, a schedule dashboard, responsive layouts and tenant theme colours
Create, edit, hide and delete services with uploaded photos, custom categories and team assignments; existing appointment history is preserved
Back-office media library with multiple image uploads, cropping, folder and usage filters, URL copying and unused-image cleanup
Editable team photos with upload, cropping and media reuse; personal IdP profile photos for customers and administrators
Configurable homepage text and photos for consulting, lessons, repairs, personal care and other appointment businesses
Service discovery with search, category filters and a responsive photo-led design
Customer login and signup, saved contact details, appointment history and secure guest-booking claims
Custom app name, logo, icon, favicon and theme colours with image uploads and live preview
Front-desk reservations for existing or new clients with private payment links and safe recovery
Weekly calendar and server-verified promotion, deposit and balance quotes
Multi-service booking with qualified therapists, room availability and cleanup buffers
Full payments or deposits through Cloudgate Wallet; confirmation after verified payment
Self-service rescheduling, cancellation, booking access links and calendar downloads
Back office calendar, clients, staff hours, resources, waitlist, promotions and reports
Email outbox and scheduled reminders; payment recovery and protected refunds

summary: Payments are processed through your Cloudgate Wallet.
Configure your booking policy, business information and outgoing email before serving customers.

compliance.label: Test appointments only
compliance.text: I understand this environment uses sandbox payments.

compliance.label: Booking rules configured
compliance.text: I have configured services, working hours, cancellation rules, payment requirements and customer support details.

compliance.label: Booking and refund tested
compliance.text: I have tested a hosted sandbox booking, payment confirmation, cancellation and refund.
